This file (gif.h) is released into the public domain by its author. There are no
restrictions on its use. It is vendored into X3Native under third_party/gif_h/ and
used only by the headless --capture-ai tool to assemble an animated GIF from the
captured PNG frame sequence. See ../../THIRDPARTY_LICENSES.md.
